chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Abān ibn Taghlib, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Concerning a group of pilgrims in ihram who struck ostrich chicks and all ate of them, he said: “For them, in place of every chick that they ate, is a camel, in which they all share together. So they purchase it according to the number of the chicks and according to the number of the men.”

key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a camel offered as sacrificial compensation
key_terms.مُحْرِمِينَ: those in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What is obligatory for muhrims who kill and eat ostrich chicks during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning pilgrims in the state of ihram who killed and ate ostrich chicks. For each chick, a badanah (camel) is due, and the group shares jointly in fulfilling that compensation.
